-75.40320,40.09730.name: Reproductive Medicine Associates of Philadelphia
-75.40320,40.09730.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Arthur J. Castelbaum, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-100.50000,47.50000.name: Feral herbicide-tolerant canola with stacked traits, roadsides
-100.50000,47.50000.type: Canola, feral populations with stacked traits
-100.50000,47.50000.desc: Canola growing wild along North Dakota roadsides, carrying herbicide-tolerance traits — and some plants carrying traits from two different companies, a combination nobody bred, made by plants breeding with each other outside any field.

-48.40000,-1.35000.name: Agropalma / palm and tropical oils
-48.40000,-1.35000.desc: Brazilian palm oil production in the Amazon basin, certified and audited against deforestation criteria. Palm expansion in South America is far smaller than in southeast Asia and growing, and it is the case where certification is being applied from the start rather than retrofitted after the clearing.

-93.21000,44.85600.name: Land O’Lakes — WinField United
-93.21000,44.85600.state: Arden Hills, Minnesota — 4001 Lexington Avenue North
-93.21000,44.85600.desc: A farmer-owned cooperative that is also one of the largest US distributors of seed and crop chemicals. Co-operatives sit between the trait owners and the field, and they decide which varieties a farmer is actually offered — a choke point that no approval process examines.

35.20300,31.78300.name: Chief Rabbinate — kashrut and cultivated meat
35.20300,31.78300.desc: Ruled on whether cultivated meat grown from animal cells is meat, dairy or neither — a question with no precedent, in the country where cultivated meat was approved earliest. Religious authorities are making category decisions about engineered products before any secular regulator has settled the same question.

8.68330,53.86670.name: Lohmann Tierzucht
8.68330,53.86670.state: Cuxhaven, Germany — an EW Group company
8.68330,53.86670.desc: The market leader in white egg layer genetics, and one of three layer brands inside the same German family holding company alongside Hy-Line International and H&N. Almost every white egg eaten anywhere descends from a handful of closed breeding lines, and those lines are the asset: a commercial farm buys parent stock and cannot breed replacements from it, because the performance comes from crossing lines the farm does not hold. That is the same structure as a hybrid seed and it long predates any engineered organism — which is exactly why it belongs on a map about who controls reproduction.
